- Maximizing Average Income
  - Dist 1 has the highest average: 21.6k, so Dist 1.

  - Feasible: Dist 1 (12k) and Dist 2 (13k); Dist 1 wins by average: Dist 1.
- Maximizing Average with Floor Constraint ≤ 14,000

Under Reading B (≤), Dist 3 is feasible but Dist 1 is also feasible (and has higher average), so Dist 1 would win again. So Dist 3 is not the correct choice under either standard reading.

Takeaways
- The math lines up nicely when you compute floor, average, and range for each distribution.
